# Elasticsearch and OpenSearch (`source_type: elasticsearch`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Runs one search with an aggregation and reports the value of the named aggregation. Documents are never stored.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: value of the named aggregation, as returned by the query; Observer does not rescale it

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | yes | string |  | URL |
| `index` | yes | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `query` | yes | object |  |  |
| `agg_name` | yes | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `percentile` | no | string |  |  |
| `flavor` | no | enum | `"elasticsearch"` | `elasticsearch`, `opensearch` |
| `auth_mode` | no | enum | `"none"` | `none`, `bearer`, `basic`, `api_key` |
| `token_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `username` | no | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `password_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `api_key_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `10000` | 100 to 60000 |

## Rules

- `query` is the search body and must contain an `aggs` (or `aggregations`) block. `agg_name` names the aggregation to read; `percentile` picks a key from a percentiles aggregation.
- `auth_mode: bearer` needs `token_ref`; `basic` needs `username` and `password_ref`; `api_key` needs `api_key_ref`.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: elasticsearch
source_config: {"base_url":"https://es.internal:9200","index":"logs-*","query":{"query":{"match":{"level":"error"}},"aggs":{"errors":{"value_count":{"field":"_id"}}}},"agg_name":"errors"}
```
